mask_display.color_scale: Fixed P_target range0..1; no per-image minmax. Coarse grid upsampling does not create fine independent evidence.
mask_display.transform: Raw32logit→bilinear originalHW align_corners=False→sigmoid for P_target; binary mask logit>=0 / P_target>=.5.

mask_training_target.complement: Non-target combines background, pallet holes, foreign objects and wrong-q locations; not a separate foreign-object class.
mask_training_target.source: Original SYN M4 uint8>127 visible target silhouette
mask_training_target.transform: Whole binary M4→torch bilinear512 align_corners=False antialias=True→avgpool16→32x32 fractional target; no GT crop.

methods.input: Whole RGB for original R0 detector; N3/SubPix are historical pointwise coordinate processing. Numbered oldq is a correspondence/display reference.
methods.limitation: Do not interpret heatmap peak or original confidence as visibility. This audit does not recertify every historical N3/SubPix implementation.
methods.output: 9 coordinates plus original keypoint/canvas confidence; no new semantic E output.
methods.supervision: Original R0 keypoint-coordinate/canvas-validity training; no new training here. Original point confidence is not native external-occlusion probability.

methods.input: Only historical stored per-native D/E/U outputs are reused here. Exact legacy input recipe is not re-audited in V271.
methods.limitation: Do not label this model SYN-only; input details are intentionally left unspecified rather than guessed.
methods.output: Stored D/E/U labels; historical comparison, not a controlled architecture ablation.
methods.supervision: Historical own-real CAL training exposure; separate from new SYN-only methods.

methods.input: Frozen YOLO P3 9x9 ROI + source-valid channel at unchanged initial predicted q; one new local classifier.
methods.limitation: Target absence can mean background, target hole, wrong q, external object or virtual boundary, not uniquely external occlusion.
methods.output: Whether target pallet occupies the queried image pixel.
methods.supervision: Original SYN1003 TRAIN768/DEV235. Center pixel M4[floor(q+.5)]>127. M0 auxiliary; no native semantic D/E gold.

methods.input: Initial-q-centered crop, frozen DINOv2 patch features, externally supplied native ID. V264 pools local features around frozen heatmap softargmax plus global features and aux12.
methods.limitation: A sharp heatmap is a learned location hypothesis, not proof that the point is visible. V264 does not output full-image segmentation.
methods.output: V263 location heatmap/softargmax and separate visibility; V264 new pointwise E classifier with frozen heatmap/coordinates.
methods.supervision: V263 geometry/material-anchor/edge-witness localization teacher, not photometric native gold. V264 source synthetic D0/E1; S/U ignored; different corpus from original1003.

methods.input: Entire RGB→PIL bicubic512square, CLIP normalization; frozen OpenAI ViT-B/16 dense32x32 projected tokens→small learned pallet mask head. CS uses architecture surgery, no text-feature surgery.
methods.limitation: This is a trained binary pallet segmenter on CLIP features, not a text-prompt zero-shot attention map or native external-cause classifier.
methods.output: One-channel target-pallet mask logit32x32; fixed q sample is an additional mask-presence proxy.
methods.supervision: Original SYN M4 visible-target pixel mask only, TRAIN768/DEV235. No q/native/pose/M0 input to mask generation.

methods.input: Entire RGB512square; same small mask head. STANDARD→CSA keeps generic EVA weights and changes dense attention/readout; CSA→DECLIP keeps CSA path and changes released adapted weights.
methods.limitation: New pallet-head fits are SYN-only; not all pretrained weights are SYN-only. OpenAI→EVA also changes backbone/pretraining package, not only one algorithm.
methods.output: One-channel target mask32x32. Sampling original q gives target-presence D/E proxy, not native visibility.
methods.supervision: Same original SYN M4 and splits as V267; three fixed final1000 pallet-head fits. Released DeCLIP encoder has public COCO-image dense adaptation/DINO teacher history.

methods.input: Whole RGB→reflect101 pad100→square640 letterbox. Original R0 shared pose cv4 stem plus new per-channel E head; frozen backbone/neck and existing terminal xy/canvas readout.
methods.limitation: Not segmentation. Strict filtering left TRAIN raw2/3/6/7 with D0, yielding E-only slot supervision. On current223 JOINT0/1 alwaysD,2/3/6/7 alwaysE; this is not corrected by displaying better coordinates.
methods.output: 9 xy coordinates plus native8 semantic E logits; centroid E ignored.
methods.supervision: Original SYN1003, strict external9ray fraction0=D,>=.5=E; partial/self/outside ignored. Joint also supervises projected virtual8+centroid coordinates. No M4 supervision.

query_readout.CLIP_D_E: P_target>=.5→D proxy; otherwise E proxy; originalq not moved. Historical unavailable45 are retained for mask-query metrics.
query_readout.V270_D_E: Separate E head P_E>=.5→E; otherwise D. Input is full image, no oldq input or mask sample.
query_readout.sample: grid_sample raw32logit at normalized(2*(q+.5)/[W,H]-1),align_corners=False,padding_mode=border; sigmoid after sampling.

scientific_limits: Real segmentation visual plausibility is qualitative; native D/E confusion does not measure segmentation IoU.
A visually good target mask may exclude the exact virtual corner/q or include target material unrelated to the native point.
M4 does not teach invisible whole-pallet/amodal silhouette or external occluder identity.
SYN235 is repeatedly exposed development data; numeric SYN segmentation success does not certify independent real transfer.
V270 slot collapse follows teacher selection/slot priors; world ground-height coincidence does not prove floor ray first-hit ownership.
